display_name: LocalRidge继承残差分类头完整support对照
description: 固定R_seq候选与R0/R_reset对照；旧类B监督训练，C继承后全注册类共同训练；沿用160组support身份。
authorization: User authorized legal target-support supervised fine-tuning and benchmark reuse; root sole launch owner.

code.commit_note: Preparation parent; publisher records actual pushed release commit in launch/startup.

data.dataset: Support slices only from the two existing VALIDATED_ONCE capsules
data.representation: Existing immutable support-only z_id/fft/t_emb/f_emb/pa_local; same single received observation
data.split_id: Explicit selected 40 support splits per cohort; complete original producer matrix retained
data.validation_ref: Existing cohort capsule manifests; no data rebuild or revalidation
data.support_query_ref: Only registered support_indices/support_labels are consumed; query excluded
data.reuse_policy: VALIDATED_ONCE; runtime artifact identity/binding checks only, no new data validation

permissions.truth_use: Train support labels for B/C supervised training; held support labels only after fixed scores; no query

checkpoint.initialization: Exact source-only scratch final200 model; eval and frozen; no changed buffers or weights
checkpoint.selection_rule: Two smallest fixed source model seeds, final200, selected from metadata before results
checkpoint.inheritance_policy: Only original source-only model; no historical adapted head/cache state
checkpoint.current_auxiliary_training: Frozen source encoder caches; residual B/C states trained only on each legal support train fold; no external target-trained state
checkpoint.feature_cache_producer_role: support-only raw frozen features; no learned state

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; two lanes with two BLAS threads each; no encoder/checkpoint loading
execution.stop_rule: Technical failure fails only its lane; healthy lanes finish. No automatic retry, no stopping for weak support diagnostics.

notes: R_seq is the only candidate; R0 and R_reset are fixed explanatory controls.
Same 160 support parents as the completed registration diagnostic; no query or source sample access.
True K1 numerical-only; full pilot before interpretation; ideal 10/1/3 targets are not hard gates.
Adam moments reset at every B/C stage; state inheritance is within the same physical train fold only.

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Held legal support predictions only; no query
metrics_plan.interpretation: Complete support pilot of a fixed candidate; paired old/new metrics and sequence/reset comparisons, no query claim.

probe.proxy_policy: All sorted positions 0..parent_K-1 inside each current support set; true K1 excluded

rows.purpose: Paired support test of residual capacity and sequential inheritance
rows.seed_notes: Original model/split/data/augmentation lineage retained; explicit selected support seed; deterministic evaluation.
rows.budget_ref: 40 parents;792 base fits;1144 residual stages;73216 Adam updates;fixed 3 paths
